sample_title: KD SRSF1 whole cell Replicate A
biological_replicate_evidence: Publication Methods and GEO series declare two biological replicates per condition
fraction_pair_basis: GEO series states cytoplasmic and whole-cell RNA from identical sample; A/B labels link fractions. Physical aliquot identifiers unavailable.
treatment_protocol: Seven different SR proteins were knocked down using costum-made esiRNAs and Lipofectamin2000. An esiRNA against GFP was used for mock transfections. Transfections were performed for 36 hours to minimize secondary effects on gene expression.
extract_protocol: P19 Control and Knockdown cells were harvested and separated into whole cell lysates and cytoplasmic fractions. RNA was isolated using TRIzol. PolyA+ RNA was enriched with MicroPoly(A) Purist Kit (Ambion.

mRNA isolation from 1ug total RNA was done by poly-dT enrichment using the NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module according to the manufacturers instructions. Library was prepared using TruSeq library prep kit (Illlumina).
